title: Greek Beef Saganaki
description: A classic Greek dish made with pan-seared beef saganaki and served with a side of roasted vegetables.
instructions: Season the beef saganaki with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef saganaki for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the beef is cooking, heat a separate skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic, onion, and red bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the zucchini to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the beef saganaki with the roasted vegetables on the side.
